verdict.rationale: PayPal's own API docs show it accepts per-request currencies using ISO-4217 codes, so you can price charges in multiple currencies. It also documents a control to block or unblock incoming payments in a currency you don't hold, which implies multi-currency balance handling. Nothing in the pack covers converting and settling to the merchant's bank in their home currency, or how FX rates and fees are disclosed. missing for 10: documented settlement to the merchant's bank in their home currency, transparent FX rate and conversion-fee disclosure, list of supported presentment currencies, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: To specify currencies in request URI and body parameters, use three-character ISO-4217 codes.
Block or unblock payments sent to you in a currency you don't hold.
